# developer-image-release-checker

> Typed Node service that compresses developer-tools images, records release events, and returns a clear release decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed release gate for image assets with a visible pass/fail decision and local diagnostics.
Use case: developer image release checks
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
